Lemma
[covering is bounded by capacity]

Source: petersen:page-0416 ↗ def:pet-ch11-capacity-covering-functions The covering and capacity numbers satisfy $\Cov (\varepsilon )\le \Cap (\varepsilon )$.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch11-cov-le-cap \sketch Take a maximal disjoint family of $\varepsilon /2$-balls. Maximality forces the concentric $\varepsilon $-balls to cover $X$, so their number gives $\Cov _X(\varepsilon )\le \Cap _X(\varepsilon )$.

□
